name: Umezma
source: Umezma is a first-person horror game based on the story "Rusty Scissors" from the manga "Kami no Hidarite, Akuma no Migite" by Kazuo Umezu. It was released as part of a series of interactive manga called MangaRom.
translation: Umezma是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，改编自Kazuo Umezu的漫画《Kami no Hidarite, Akuma no Migite》中的故事“Rusty Scissors”。它是作为名为MangaRom的互动漫画系列的一部分发布的。
